trending.title: EU needs a system to respond to AI incidents, Finland and Estonia say
trending.body: In a letter seen by POLITICO, Finland and Estonia call for “EU-level arrangements for responding to serious AI incidents.” This comes as European leaders are set to meet Friday to debate AI for the first time.
